facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident - pressure exposure at PSV-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-4210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-4210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-4210 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 22 September 2025 a high potential incident was recorded on PSV-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
